list.name: session_id
list.query: SELECT session_id::text AS __value, coalesce(ai_title, session_id::text) AS __text FROM claude.v_session_token_summary ORDER BY first_event_at DESC

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model AS __text, model AS __value FROM claude.api_calls WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND model IS NOT NULL ORDER BY model

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(total_input_tokens),0) + coalesce(sum(output_tokens),0) AS total_tokens FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))

SELECT round(sum(cache_read_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(total_input_tokens),0) * 100, 2) AS cache_read_pct FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))
SELECT duration_seconds FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT array_to_string(models, ', ') AS models FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
SELECT subagent_count, transcript_count FROM claude.v_session_token_summary WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}

SELECT round(avg(delta_seconds), 1) AS avg_interval_seconds FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND call_index > 1 AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))

SELECT call_index, total_input_tokens + output_tokens AS tokens FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY call_index

SELECT e.call_index, e.cache_read_pct FROM claude.v_call_cache_efficiency e WHERE e.session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR e.call_index IN (SELECT call_index FROM claude.v_call_detail d WHERE d.session_id = e.session_id AND d.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) ORDER BY e.call_index

SELECT e.call_index, e.context_growth_tokens FROM claude.v_call_cache_efficiency e WHERE e.session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR e.call_index IN (SELECT call_index FROM claude.v_call_detail d WHERE d.session_id = e.session_id AND d.model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ',')))) ORDER BY e.call_index

SELECT call_index, delta_seconds FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND call_index > 1 AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY call_index
SELECT kind, call_index, called_at, delta_seconds FROM claude.v_long_gaps WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY delta_seconds DESC

SELECT agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY agent, agent_type, depth, parent_agent ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, sum(total_input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens FROM claude.v_call_detail WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring} AND ('${model:csv}' = '' OR model = ANY(string_to_array('${model:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY model ORDER BY tokens DESC
